description: This Java class implements the CommandStrategy interface for creating a new datatable entry in the Fineract platform. It processes batch requests to create entries associated with a specific datatable and loan, invoking the DatatablesApiResource to perform the operation and handling responses accordingly.

classes.name: CreateDatatableEntryCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements CommandStrategy to handle creation of datatable entries related to loans via batch processing.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a BatchRequest to create a new datatable entry by extracting path parameters, invoking the DatatablesApiResource, and constructing a BatchResponse.
